sentences.en: This has been the longest year in the history of this city.
sentences.zh: 这是这座城市历史上最漫长的一年。

sentences.en: Longest year, the toughest year and a year where there was so much that we had to overcome together.
sentences.zh: 最漫长的一年，最艰难的一年，也是我们必须共同克服重重困难的一年。

sentences.en: Over the past year,
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，

sentences.en: New York City has confronted two major forces.
sentences.zh: 纽约市面临了两大主要挑战。

sentences.en: New York City, the epicenter of the COVID-19 pandemic in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 纽约市，美国新冠疫情的震中。

sentences.en: A pandemic that hit the city harder than any place in the country and exposed the depth of its inequities.
sentences.zh: 一场对该市打击比全国任何地方都严重，并暴露了其深层不平等的疫情。

sentences.en: The report from the mayor's office calls COVID-19 the largest mass fatality incident in modern New York City history.
sentences.zh: 市长办公室的报告称，新冠疫情是现代纽约市历史上最大规模的群体性死亡事件。

sentences.en: And massive protests over race and policing that prompted calls to rethink and defund the NYPD.
sentences.zh: 以及引发了重新思考和削减纽约警察局经费呼声的大规模种族与警务抗议活动。

sentences.en: We demand that our city defund the NYPD.
sentences.zh: 我们要求我们的城市削减纽约警察局的经费。

sentences.en: And so as the race to replace New York City's mayor got underway, it seemed like those two issues would become central to the campaign.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着纽约市长竞选的展开，这两个问题似乎成为了竞选的核心。

sentences.en: And that's how it started.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样开始的。

sentences.en: We need to make New York City the COVID comeback city, but also the anti-poverty city.
sentences.zh: 我们需要让纽约市成为新冠疫情后的复苏之城，同时也要成为消除贫困之城。

sentences.en: The candidates talked about the best and fairest way to bring back an economy battered by lockdowns.
sentences.zh: 候选人们讨论了如何以最好、最公平的方式重振被封锁措施重创的经济。

sentences.en: Policing is fundamentally broken in this country.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的警务工作从根本上是崩溃的。

sentences.en: And they talked about how to change policing.
sentences.zh: 他们讨论了如何改变警务工作。

sentences.en: Or maybe it's not broken, it's just working exactly how it's supposed to.
sentences.zh: 或者也许它并没有崩溃，它只是在完全按照预定的方式运作。

sentences.en: And the point about what people are demanding is then break it, then make it different.
sentences.zh: 人们要求的重点是，既然它坏了，那就把它拆掉，然后重建一个不同的。

sentences.en: We have become a safe haven for those who want to use their power in an abusive way and not in a corrective way.
sentences.zh: 我们已经成为了那些想要滥用权力而非纠正错误的人的避风港。

sentences.en: With some of them calling for huge cuts in the police budget.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人呼吁大幅削减警察预算。

sentences.en: It's time to move a billion dollars from one police plaza into the streets of our city.
sentences.zh: 是时候把警察广场的十亿美元投入到我们城市的街道上了。

sentences.en: It was exactly the kind of campaign with a progressive consensus at its core that you'd expect in a deep blue Democratic city.
sentences.zh: 这正是你在一个深蓝色的民主党城市所预期的那种以进步共识为核心的竞选活动。

sentences.en: But then, over the past few months, the campaign started to change and the consensus started to unravel.
sentences.zh: 但随后，在过去几个月里，竞选活动开始发生变化，共识也开始瓦解。

sentences.en: An alarming surge in shootings around New York City.
sentences.zh: 纽约市各地的枪击事件惊人地激增。

sentences.en: Violence was on the rise, in New York and almost every major American city.
sentences.zh: 暴力事件在纽约和几乎所有美国主要城市都在上升。

sentences.en: We do talk a lot about gun insanity here on Eyewitness News these days.
sentences.zh: 这些天我们在《目击者新闻》确实谈论了很多关于枪支疯狂的问题。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, lately, New York City is becoming no stranger to gun violence and shooting incidents.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，最近纽约市对枪支暴力和枪击事件已不再陌生。

sentences.en: Overall crime was down.
sentences.zh: 总体犯罪率有所下降。

sentences.en: But by the end of 2020, murders were up 45% in New York.
sentences.zh: 但到2020年底，纽约的谋杀案增加了45%。

sentences.en: Shootings were up 97%.
sentences.zh: 枪击事件增加了97%。

sentences.en: And week after week, there were acts of violence that shocked the city.
sentences.zh: 而且一周又一周，发生了震惊全城的暴力行为。

sentences.en: A deadly stabbing spree on the subway.
sentences.zh: 地铁上发生了一起致命的连环捅人事件。

sentences.en: Four separate attacks that stretched from Queens to upper Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 四起独立的袭击事件，从皇后区一直延伸到上曼哈顿。

sentences.en: Tonight, Times Square is a crime scene.
sentences.zh: 今晚，时代广场成了犯罪现场。

sentences.en: After a shooting sent crowds running.
sentences.zh: 此前一场枪击事件导致人群四散奔逃。

sentences.en: Three people were injured, including a four-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 三人受伤，其中包括一名四岁女孩。

sentences.en: Tragic shooting in Queens.
sentences.zh: 皇后区发生悲剧性枪击事件。

sentences.en: Deadly gunfire that ended the life of a 10-year-old boy.
sentences.zh: 致命的枪声夺去了一名10岁男孩的生命。

sentences.en: The latest shootings are part of the rise in gun violence across the city.
sentences.zh: 最近的枪击事件是全市枪支暴力上升的一部分。

sentences.en: And increasingly, children are the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 而且受害者越来越多地是儿童。

sentences.en: Polls started to show that public safety was voters' top issue.
sentences.zh: 民调开始显示，公共安全是选民最关心的问题。

sentences.en: Thank you, candidates.
sentences.zh: 谢谢各位候选人。

sentences.en: I'm going to start with the first question, and it's about public safety.
sentences.zh: 我先问第一个问题，是关于公共安全的。

sentences.en: Violence dominated a series of candidate debates.
sentences.zh: 暴力事件主导了一系列候选人辩论。

sentences.en: No surprise, we're going to start tonight the first question on crime.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，我们今晚从第一个关于犯罪的问题开始。

sentences.en: And the driving question of the race suddenly became how exactly to keep New York City safe.
sentences.zh: 而这场竞选的驱动性问题突然变成了究竟该如何保障纽约市的安全。

sentences.en: With fewer police?
sentences.zh: 是减少警察吗？

sentences.en: We are going to stop the hiring in the next two police cadet classes.
sentences.zh: 我们将停止招聘接下来的两批警察学员。

sentences.en: As I have said, we have a police department that is bloated.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我们的警察部门臃肿不堪。

sentences.en: A $6 billion...
sentences.zh: 60亿美元的……

sentences.en: Or with more of them.
sentences.zh: 还是增加警察？

sentences.en: I do not agree with defund the police.
sentences.zh: 我不同意削减警察经费。

sentences.en: I do believe in community policing and rethinking and reforming.
sentences.zh: 我确实相信社区警务，相信重新思考和改革。

sentences.en: The police need to be equipped to fight crime in any circumstance.
sentences.zh: 警察需要有能力在任何情况下打击犯罪。

sentences.en: And if anything, we need to go on a massive recruitment drive for new police officers.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么的话，我们需要为新警察进行大规模的招募活动。

sentences.en: We must wake up when all families are dealing with the issues of gun violence.
sentences.zh: 当所有家庭都在应对枪支暴力问题时，我们必须警醒。

sentences.en: Today, as New York City voters head to the polls, we talk to two of them about an election that is testing the city's values.
sentences.zh: 今天，随着纽约市选民前往投票站，我们采访了其中两位，谈论这场正在考验城市价值观的选举。

sentences.zh: 今天是6月22日，星期二。

sentences.zh: 现在是周一晚上7点左右，距离民主党初选和市长竞选大约还有一周时间。

sentences.zh: 我们位于阿姆斯特丹大道100号街区附近，这里是上西区开始融入晨边高地的地段。

sentences.zh: 这是一个美丽、晴朗、微风习习的夏夜。

sentences.zh: 我们在这里采访两位民主党选民，她们真正体现了这场市长竞选的核心矛盾，即如何处理犯罪问题

sentences.en: and what role the police should play in that.

sentences.en: And in this case, that tension is playing out inside a single household, inside a single apartment, between a mother and a daughter.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这种矛盾在同一个家庭、同一间公寓里，在母亲和女儿之间上演。

sentences.zh: 以前是什么样？

sentences.zh: 嗯，当我们来到阿姆斯特丹大道时，这里有很多毒贩。

sentences.zh: 我是说，这里相当破败。

sentences.zh: 你不会想在深夜走在那条街上，尤其是女性。

sentences.zh: 我是纽约人。

sentences.zh: 美佐子在曼哈顿中城的一家奢侈品百货公司担任个人导购，在封锁最严格的时期，她被停薪留职了。

sentences.en: And when the store finally reopened last summer, business was way down.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天商店终于重新开业时，生意非常冷清。

sentences.en: And because she works on commission, she earned about a third of what she had before the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 因为她是靠佣金工作的，所以她赚的钱大约只有疫情前三分之一。

sentences.en: Yumi, meanwhile, had lost her job before COVID hit and decided to move back in with her mother.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，尤米在新冠疫情爆发前就失业了，决定搬回来和母亲住。

sentences.en: So we kind of have this ritual.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有一种仪式感。

sentences.en: We make dinner and then go sit in the living room and watch CNN.
sentences.zh: 我们做晚饭，然后坐在客厅看 CNN。

sentences.en: And it's usually me just, you know, I guess, getting pretty riled up.
sentences.zh: 通常都是我，你知道，我想，变得非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And so day after day, night after night, the two of them have experienced the events of the past year together.
sentences.zh: 就这样，日复一日，夜复一夜，她们两人一起经历了过去一年的事件。

sentences.en: And they have debated them endlessly.
sentences.zh: 她们对此进行了无休止的辩论。

sentences.en: But, I mean, starting with the murder of George Floyd and with Breonna Taylor's murder as well, like,
sentences.zh: 但是，从乔治·弗洛伊德的谋杀案以及布伦娜·泰勒的谋杀案开始，就像，

sentences.en: I was at home and I was supposed to be doing all of these, you know, applying to a million jobs and, like, working on all these side projects.
sentences.zh: 我当时在家里，本应该做所有这些事情，你知道，申请一百万份工作，还有，处理所有这些副业项目。

sentences.en: But to me, it kind of felt a little meaningless to, like, not put my body on the streets and, you know,

sentences.en: join other people in the city to make our voices heard and to show,

sentences.zh: 我和一个住得近的朋友，

sentences.zh: 我们会参加我们能参加的每一场抗议活动，因为这感觉是我参与过的最直接的行动形式，因为，你知道，

sentences.en: the more bodies, like, the harder it is for cops to, you know, shut it down.
sentences.zh: 人越多，警察就越难，你知道，阻止它。

sentences.en: So the first night when I think de Blasio put the curfew, we stayed out and we were at Battery City Park, like,
sentences.zh: 所以第一天晚上，当白思豪实施宵禁时，我们留在了外面，我们在炮台公园，就像，

sentences.zh: 就在进入布鲁克林的隧道前，他们排好了警察。

sentences.en: And then there were cops behind us pushing us down and they had cars, like, driving straight through where we were all, you know, walking.
sentences.zh: 然后我们身后有警察在推我们，他们有车，就像，直接开过我们所有人，你知道，行走的地方。

sentences.en: I mean, going to protests, that's when I really realized that they truly don't care.
sentences.zh: 我是说，去参加抗议活动，那时我才真正意识到他们根本不在乎。

sentences.en: And at a certain point over the summer, those protests evolve.
sentences.zh: 到了夏天某个时候，那些抗议活动演变了。

sentences.en: And in places like New York, the rallying cry becomes to defund the police.
sentences.zh: 在纽约等地，抗议的口号变成了“削减警察经费”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 你能谈谈“削减警察经费”吗？你是怎么想的？对此有何看法？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, I don't want my tax money going towards paying for riot gear that costs a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，我不希望我的税款被用来购买那些昂贵的防暴装备。

sentences.en: I don't want to pay for these cops to be on overtime to, you know, barge through Washington Square Park and make a scene and just arrest people randomly to, like, I guess,
sentences.zh: 我不想花钱让这些警察加班，你知道，冲进华盛顿广场公园大闹一场，随意逮捕路人，我想，

sentences.en: display their power.
sentences.zh: 只是为了展示他们的权力。

sentences.en: And I don't think that throwing more money at this essentially brotherhood that protects one another is going to solve the issues that are, you know, very prevalent in our cities.
sentences.zh: 而且我不认为向这个本质上互相包庇的兄弟会投入更多资金，就能解决我们城市中非常普遍的问题。

sentences.en: So it appealed to you, this concept of defund the police.
sentences.zh: 所以“削减警察经费”这个概念很吸引你。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I am very defund the police.
sentences.zh: 我非常支持削减警察经费。

sentences.en: I think that's the first step in eventually abolishing the police.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是最终废除警察制度的第一步。

sentences.en: I mean, it's hard for people to imagine that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们很难想象这一点。

sentences.en: And I think that that is like a generational difference where I think that personally there are other means of providing safety and we need to understand, like,
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种代际差异，就我个人而言，我认为有其他方式可以提供安全保障，我们需要理解，比如，

sentences.en: at the root of why maybe there is crime.
sentences.zh: 犯罪产生的根源可能是什么。

sentences.en: And I think that money going towards, you know, more resources for schools that are completely underfunded, more resources towards, you know, helping people get jobs,
sentences.zh: 我认为资金应该投入到，你知道，为那些资金严重不足的学校提供更多资源，投入更多资源去，你知道，帮助人们找到工作，

sentences.en: providing them with housing that will hopefully, I think, decrease crime.
sentences.zh: 为他们提供住房，我想这有望减少犯罪。

sentences.en: So given all that, I want to understand what you have made of the rise in gun violence in New York City.
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，我想了解你对纽约市枪支暴力激增有何看法。

sentences.en: And that actually started before the protests and then it continued since the protests.
sentences.zh: 这实际上在抗议活动之前就开始了，并且在抗议活动之后仍在持续。

sentences.en: And as somebody who was out there protesting, calling for defunding the police, what did you make of that?
sentences.zh: 作为一名走上街头抗议、呼吁削减警察经费的人，你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: Did you immediately start to see it as a challenge to that?
sentences.zh: 你是否立刻将其视为对该运动的挑战？

sentences.en: I could see from a perspective that's not defund the police, that that would be a challenge for the defund the police movement.
sentences.zh: 我可以从不支持削减警察经费的角度理解，那确实会对该运动构成挑战。

sentences.en: But I really think that, you know, the police don't provide more safety.
sentences.zh: 但我真的认为，你知道，警察并不能提供更多的安全保障。

sentences.en: They don't decrease gun violence.
sentences.zh: 他们并不能减少枪支暴力。

sentences.en: You know, like, if you want to decrease gun violence, like, that starts with creating laws to maybe prevent more people from getting guns.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你想减少枪支暴力，那得从制定法律开始，也许能防止更多人获得枪支。

sentences.en: What exactly do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话具体是什么意思？

sentences.en: Because at the end of the day, isn't it cops who enforce gun laws once they're made?
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，法律制定后，不还是警察在执行枪支法吗？

sentences.en: Isn't it cops who eventually have to go seize an illegal gun?
sentences.zh: 最终去查缴非法枪支的不还是警察吗？

sentences.en: I guess, you know, with gun violence, like, obviously it needs to end.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，对于枪支暴力，显然它必须结束。

sentences.en: But I think that if you put more resources into preventing why people might get guns or, like, to, you know, build better communities, you know,
sentences.zh: 但我认为，如果你投入更多资源去预防人们为何会获得枪支，或者，你知道，去建设更好的社区，你知道，

sentences.en: give people opportunities that they might not otherwise have, maybe that would also lead to a decrease.
sentences.zh: 给人们提供他们本来可能没有的机会，也许这也会导致犯罪减少。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But it would take time.
sentences.zh: 但这需要时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't think this is, like, overnight, but, you know, it just takes a lot of reimagining how we as a society are safe.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不认为这是一夜之间就能完成的，但你知道，这需要我们重新构想作为社会如何才能获得安全。

sentences.en: You know, to one person, the police could be providing safety, this idea of safety.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对一个人来说，警察可能提供了安全感，这种安全的概念。

sentences.en: But to another group of people, they could be a serious threat.
sentences.zh: 但对另一群人来说，他们可能是一种严重的威胁。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, I mean, I think that the experience of others, like, black and brown people, are significantly worse.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，我认为其他人的经历，比如黑人和棕色人种，要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: And that's what makes me, you know, that's what gets me upset.
sentences.zh: 这就是让我，你知道，这就是让我感到难过的原因。

sentences.en: Like, I wasn't out there for me.
sentences.zh: 我走上街头并不是为了我自己。

sentences.en: Like, I was out there for the other people.
sentences.zh: 我是为了其他人。

sentences.en: But when you say black and brown, you don't put yourself in that category.
sentences.zh: 但当你提到黑人和棕色人种时，你并没有把自己归入那一类。

sentences.en: No, I mean, I guess I'm racially ambiguous, but I am able to, like, operate in different spaces.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，我想我的种族身份比较模糊，但我能够在不同的空间里游走。

sentences.en: And I've never had to really deal with the police.
sentences.zh: 而且我从来没有真正需要和警察打交道。

sentences.en: So it is interesting that you've been experiencing all this, the death of George Floyd, the protests, all while living here with your mother.
sentences.zh: 所以很有趣，你经历了这一切，乔治·弗洛伊德之死、抗议活动，同时还一直和母亲住在这里。

sentences.en: So I assume you have talked, the two of you, about this a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜你们俩一定经常讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: A lot.
sentences.zh: 经常讨论。

sentences.en: And what have your conversations with your mother been like as you have arrived at this place?
sentences.zh: 当你得出现在的结论时，你和你母亲的谈话是怎样的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's been difficult.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这很困难。

sentences.en: I mean, I guess I could be better at trying to explain things.
sentences.zh: 我想我本可以更好地去解释这些事情。

sentences.en: But I, it's like, I want you to trust my, you know, my stance, but it doesn't seem to work.
sentences.zh: 但我，就像是，我希望你能信任我的，你知道，我的立场，但这似乎行不通。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不行。

sentences.en: It gets heated.
sentences.zh: 谈话会变得很激烈。

sentences.en: I understand she's very passionate, but I also don't agree on a lot of things she says.
sentences.zh: 我理解她非常热心，但我也不同意她说的很多事情。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'll tell her, but, you know, she doesn't like hearing it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我会告诉她，但她不喜欢听。

sentences.en: And she gets upset if I don't agree with her.
sentences.zh: 如果我不同意她的观点，她会很生气。

sentences.en: What do you think when you hear Yumi, for example, calling to defund the police?
sentences.zh: 当你听到由美（Yumi）呼吁削减警察经费时，你是怎么想的？

sentences.en: I don't think it's a good idea.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是个好主意。

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我不认为。

sentences.en: There has to be changes in the police department, for sure.
sentences.zh: 警察部门确实需要改革。

sentences.en: It's ugly.
sentences.zh: 现状很糟糕。

sentences.en: There are issues.
sentences.zh: 确实存在问题。

sentences.en: But we do need the police department.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实需要警察部门。

sentences.en: I do feel safe.
sentences.zh: 我确实感到安全。

sentences.en: I take the subway.
sentences.zh: 我乘坐地铁。

sentences.en: You feel safe when you see them?
sentences.zh: 看到他们时你会感到安全吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, I mean, just being there.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，我的意思是，只要他们在那里就行。

sentences.en: And especially where there has been a lot of crimes, just like during the day, slashing, you know, Asian hate, all this going on.
sentences.zh: 特别是在犯罪频发的地方，就在白天，割伤事件，你知道，针对亚裔的仇恨，所有这些都在发生。

sentences.en: And it's like these violent things are happening so randomly.
sentences.zh: 这些暴力事件发生得太随机了。

sentences.en: It's not like always late at night.
sentences.zh: 并不总是发生在深夜。

sentences.en: It's during the day.
sentences.zh: 是在白天发生的。

sentences.en: So when I go to work in the morning, if I see a police officer, it's just, there's a relief.
sentences.zh: 所以当我早上上班时，如果我看到一名警察，就会感到一种解脱。

sentences.en: Did you feel less safe during this past year?
sentences.zh: 过去这一年你感到安全感降低了吗？

sentences.en: I mean, going back to work, I was very cautious who was around me.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，回到工作岗位时，我对周围的人非常警惕。

sentences.en: You know, if I sensed something was off or like that person was, I would not get on the car or, you know, the train car.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我感觉到有什么不对劲，或者那个人，我就不会上那节车厢，或者，你知道，那列火车。

sentences.en: I'd go to the other side or on a platform.
sentences.zh: 我会走到另一边或者站台上。

sentences.en: I've sensed somebody was a little off.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到某个人有点不对劲。

sentences.en: I'd go to the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 我会朝相反的方向走。

sentences.en: How much does that have to do with what's happened to Asian-Americans in cities like New York this past year?
sentences.zh: 这在多大程度上与过去一年纽约等城市亚裔美国人的遭遇有关？

sentences.en: I think a lot.
sentences.zh: 我觉得关系很大。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, because it just, they were like random people, you know, just during the day, morning, attacking peoples.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，因为这太，他们就像是随机的人，你知道，就在白天，早上，攻击人们。

sentences.en: And we would see it on the news, what would happen.
sentences.zh: 我们会在新闻上看到发生的事情。

sentences.en: And it was scary.
sentences.zh: 那很可怕。

sentences.en: Given that, is it fair to say that crime, public safety is at the top of the list of issues for you in the mayor's race?
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，是否可以说犯罪和公共安全是你市长竞选中最关心的问题？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: I mean, defunding the police?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，削减警察经费？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: It's not going to work for me, you know?
sentences.zh: 这对我来说行不通，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And just so I understand why, why that feels so wrong to you.
sentences.zh: 为了让我理解原因，为什么这让你觉得如此错误。

sentences.en: I mean, you started to talk about that a minute ago.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你刚才谈到过这一点。

sentences.en: Do you want to see more police on the streets and in the subways?
sentences.zh: 你希望在街道和地铁上看到更多的警察吗？

sentences.en: I would like to, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我希望，是的。

sentences.en: People have to feel safe.
sentences.zh: 人们必须感到安全。

sentences.en: Maybe I might feel safe.
sentences.zh: 也许我会感到安全。

sentences.en: Like Yimiko said, maybe the person next to me might not.
sentences.zh: 就像由美子（Yimiko）说的，也许我旁边的人可能不会。

sentences.en: And I understand certain people, black people, where like a mother would say, I'm afraid for my son.
sentences.zh: 我理解某些人，黑人，就像一位母亲会说，我为我的儿子感到害怕。

sentences.en: I feel for that.
sentences.zh: 我同情这一点。

sentences.en: I can't imagine what that feels like.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象那是什么感觉。

sentences.en: But I just believe like there are good police and police are supposed to protect us.
sentences.zh: 但我只是相信，有好的警察，警察本应保护我们。

sentences.en: So help me understand how you've come to view the police that way.
sentences.zh: 那么请帮我理解你是如何以这种方式看待警察的。

sentences.en: You said when we first met that you came to this neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我们刚见面时你说过你来到这个社区。

sentences.en: 26, yeah.
sentences.zh: 26岁时，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, almost three years ago.
sentences.zh: 是的，快三年了。

sentences.en: So what was your sense of safety back then?
sentences.zh: 那么你当时的安全感如何？

sentences.en: Um, this neighborhood, it was very different then.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个社区，那时非常不同。

sentences.en: Like I mentioned, it was a lot of drug dealers on the street, you know, heroin addicts.
sentences.zh: 就像我提到的，街上有很多毒贩，你知道，海洛因成瘾者。

sentences.en: You didn't want to walk on Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 你不会想走在阿姆斯特丹大道上。

sentences.en: No, you just wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 不，你根本不会走。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Times Square was like in the 80s.
sentences.zh: 时代广场就像80年代那样。

sentences.en: It was like prostitutes, you know, porn, like movie theaters and drug dealers.
sentences.zh: 到处是妓女，你知道，色情，电影院和毒贩。

sentences.en: I mean, I walked on that street.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我走在那条街上。

sentences.en: I thought I was going to die.
sentences.zh: 我以为我要死了。

sentences.en: I just didn't realize how bad it was.
sentences.zh: 我只是没意识到情况有多糟糕。

sentences.en: And it was scary.
sentences.zh: 那很可怕。

sentences.en: So scary.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: And then some guy tried to touch me and my friend like smacked his head and said, don't touch her.
sentences.zh: 然后有个家伙试图碰我，我朋友猛地拍了他的头说，别碰她。

sentences.en: And he popped her in the head, you know, and it was just like, oh my God, you know.
sentences.zh: 他打了她的头，你知道，当时就像，天哪，你知道。

sentences.en: I'm sure there's places like that, but it was just so seedy.
sentences.zh: 我相信还有那样的地方，但当时真是太破败了。

sentences.en: And I was trying to explain what seedy looked like.
sentences.zh: 我当时试图解释“破败”是什么样子。

sentences.en: I don't think she knows.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她不知道。

sentences.en: Seedy.
sentences.zh: 破败。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Because seedy went away for a long time.
sentences.zh: 因为“破败”已经消失很久了。

sentences.en: It's the, you know, it's not a place you want to walk through.
sentences.zh: 那是，你知道，不是你想走过的地方。

sentences.en: And, you know, one time a homeless guy like smacked me in the face, but like he smacked me so hard I went down.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有一次一个流浪汉猛地打了我的脸，他打得太重了，我倒在了地上。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: When was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么时候？

sentences.en: That was like in my 20s.
sentences.zh: 那大概是我20多岁的时候。

sentences.en: I saw the guy coming and I like walked away and he was in like a shopping cart walking down.
sentences.zh: 我看到那个人走过来，我就走开了，他推着一辆购物车走过来。

sentences.en: But he was so big and tall, his arm just went out and whacked me and I went down.
sentences.zh: 但他又高又大，他的手臂伸出来猛地打了我一下，我就倒下了。

sentences.en: And then I saw stars.
sentences.zh: 然后我眼冒金星。

sentences.en: I remember the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我记得整个过程。

sentences.en: And then like my friend grabbed me and like I sat down and I was fine.
sentences.zh: 然后我朋友抓住了我，我坐了下来，我没事。

sentences.en: That's a, that's a meaningful experience to have that happened.
sentences.zh: 那是一次很有意义的经历。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯嗯。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And crime was much higher back then.
sentences.zh: 那时候犯罪率高得多。

sentences.en: Yes, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: But it's like a different type of crime.
sentences.zh: 但那是另一种类型的犯罪。

sentences.en: I don't, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, crime is crime.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，犯罪就是犯罪。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 这不重要。

sentences.en: But I mean, what I recall is the crimes were like the drug, the drug addicts stealing.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，我记得当时的犯罪就像是毒品，吸毒者在偷窃。

sentences.en: Now it's just more of the lunatics with guns.
sentences.zh: 现在只是多了些带枪的疯子而已。

sentences.en: It's more guns.
sentences.zh: 枪更多了。

sentences.en: So if someone pissed somebody off, boom, if you had a gun, that's what it feels like right now.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有人惹恼了谁，砰，如果你有把枪，现在感觉就是这样。

sentences.en: You know, like if I'm in a car with my friend, I don't want her getting in a tiff with another
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如我和朋友在车里，我不希望她和别人发生争执，

sentences.en: person because I don't know if that person might have a bad day and have a gun next to them.
sentences.zh: 因为我不知道那个人那天心情是不是很糟，身边是不是正好有把枪。

sentences.en: Things like that are, I think about more often.
sentences.zh: 像这样的事情，我想得更多一些。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So back to what it's been like for the two of you to kind of talk about this.
sentences.zh: 回到你们两人谈论这件事的感受上来。

sentences.en: I mean, how has it been like to try to reconcile these two views?
sentences.zh: 我是说，试图调和这两种观点是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I mean, we get our arguments.
sentences.zh: 我们确实会有争论。
